scenario: To further boost model privacy, BlindFed incorporates sample-level permutation and Stochastic Block Sampling (SBS). The server permutes encrypted intermediate representations and returns only a subset of block outputs, effectively mitigating potential model extraction attacks.
audio_content: BlindFed enhances privacy using sample-level permutation and stochastic block sampling, returning only a subset of outputs to thwart model extraction attacks.
